source.name: Pittsburgh Pirates / MLB.com: Pirates and Sheetz Announce Jersey Patch Partnership
source.note: Club jersey-patch page, read via the Wayback Machine capture of 2026-04-12 because the live mlb.com page blocks scripts. The club called it a multi-year partnership; TribLIVE reported it as a three-year agreement (2024-06-21).
source.quote: The Pittsburgh Pirates and Sheetz announced a multi-year partnership in which the ultimate one-stop shop convenience chain will serve as the club's first jersey patch partner.

note: Jersey patch on the sleeves of the home and away jerseys; the club's first jersey patch partner.
